mapper.select: select cp.id, cp.contract_id, cp.supplier_id, cp.supplier_account_id, cp.product_id, p.name as product_name, p.no as product_no, p.type as product_type, s.name as supplier_name, sa.account_name as supplier_account_name, sa.type as supplier_account_type, cp.cost_discount, cp.sell_discount, cp.price_detail, cp.remark from crm_contract_product cp left join crm_model_product p on cp.product_id = p.id left join crm_supplier s on cp.supplier_id = s.id left join crm_supplier_account sa on cp.supplier_account_id = sa.id where cp.deleted = 0 and cp.contract_id = #{contractId} order by cp.supplier_id, cp.product_id

select id, contract_id, supplier_id, supplier_account_id, product_id, cost_discount, sell_discount, price_detail, remark, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted from crm_contract_product where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
select count(1) from crm_contract_product where contract_id = #{contractId} and deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into crm_contract_product (contract_id, supplier_id, supplier_account_id, product_id, cost_discount, sell_discount, price_detail, remark, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted) values
(#{item.contractId}, #{item.supplierId}, #{item.supplierAccountId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.costDiscount}, #{item.sellDiscount}, #{item.priceDetail}, #{item.remark}, #{item.creator}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updater}, #{item.updateTime}, 0)
mapper.select: select distinct cp.supplier_id as supplier_id, s.name as supplier_name, cp.supplier_account_id as supplier_account_id, sa.account_name as supplier_account_name, sa.status as account_status, sa.pull_type as pull_type from crm_contract c inner join crm_contract_product cp on cp.contract_id = c.id and cp.deleted = 0 left join crm_supplier s on s.id = cp.supplier_id left join crm_supplier_account sa on sa.id = cp.supplier_account_id where c.deleted = 0 and c.status in (2, 3, 5) and c.consumer_id = #{customerId} and cp.supplier_id is not null order by cp.supplier_id, cp.supplier_account_id
